galaxy.canvas_label: The registry galaxy: every domain drawn as a cluster of subjects.
galaxy.rows_heading_council: Stars this council lands on, A to Z, {count}
galaxy.subject_footer: {count} TECHNIQUES · RANK 1 AT THE CENTRE, A TO Z OUTWARD
galaxy.legend_sky_body: One globular cluster per domain, packed so none collide and numbered in name order. The docked list prints the same numbers. The rim arc is council state.
galaxy.legend_domain_body: Categories are sub-discs, rank 1 nearest the core, A to Z outward. Disc area is how many subjects it holds.
galaxy.legend_category_body: The disc is cut into subcategory wedges, A to Z clockwise from twelve, sized by count. Inside a wedge, subjects spiral outward in name order.
galaxy.legend_subject_body: Techniques on a sunflower spiral: rank 1 at the centre, A to Z outward, sized by how many laws govern them. Hover one to light its law family.
galaxy.legend_lens_on: Lens on. It magnifies under the pointer without changing zoom.
galaxy.legend_lens_off: Lens off. Press L to magnify under the pointer without changing zoom.
galaxy.council_focus_body: The {lit} stars this council lands on are lit; the other {dimmed} are dimmed, never hidden. The docked list shows the same set, A to Z, with each one's council state.
galaxy.council_focus_escape: Escape restores the view you had before the council was opened.
galaxy.lens_hint: Magnify under the pointer without changing zoom (L)
galaxy.unpaired_description: The galaxy is drawn from a knowledge registry checkout. Pair one under Dev Tools, Workspaces, and this field fills itself.
galaxy.error_title: The registry could not be read
galaxy.corpus_empty: No council has reached this corpus yet. An unpainted galaxy is the honest first day.
